primary: A computer system executes instructions and moves data between processors and memory. Performance measurements depend on the workload, cache state, and the boundaries of the timer. An experiment should preserve the original observations and compare equivalent work. Explain how careful measurement helps a programmer understand the behavior of a system.
heldout: A community garden provides vegetables, flowers, and a place for neighbors to meet. Volunteers plan the beds, prepare the soil, save water, and share the harvest. The seasons change the tasks that need attention. Describe a practical plan for keeping a garden healthy and welcoming throughout the year.
